item.title: Github Copilot
item.description: You can create a symbolic link from /Applications/Corona/SampleCode to your @workspace/kwik-editor-proj using the ln -s command. For example, open your Terminal and run: ln -s /Applications/Corona/SampleCode /Users/ymmtny/Documents Select it to Copilot Edits for example Graphics/Flashlight/main.lua Use a sample source as guide for example App/{Book}/compoents/{PAGE}/ballon_mask.lua, ballon layer has been repalced for a mask layer in kwik editor In Copilot Edits modify M:didSHow function in ballon_mask.lua to make a obj.group animate randomly to new position smotthly, referencing how to move it in main.lua

item.title: Drawing Canvas
item.description: Drawing Canvas The following steps to make a canvas to draw with touching the screen You can download the tutorial files https://www.kwiksher.com/tutorials/Kwik4/canvas.zip the screenshots are of kwik3 but the project file is updated with Kwik4 New Project Open canvas.psd file. The psd size is for 1024x768 so let’s create a kwik project with iPad Mini. It is a good practice to click Publish button after you loaded a PSD file into Kwik to make sure every layer name is valid and then you turn it of exporting image. Now you can work to create animations, interactions etc

item.title: Scroll Images And Text
item.description: Learn how to use features: Scroll and Text replacements.
